The '''3rd Wing Guard''' was a [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] assigned to the [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]]&mdash;a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] working to protect the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrisoned]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].

==History==
When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] brought an occupation force to Cloud City,<ref name="Empire">{{Film|V}}</ref> resistance against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces resulted in the reorganization of the [[2nd Wing Guard]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] into a security force not obviously aligned with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="SWPM" />

The 3rd Wing Guard served Cloud City's [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] after Calrissian's departure, protecting it even under and in spite of the occupation of an Imperial garrison.<ref name="BWGITDB" />

==Description==
Based in [[Cloud City Security Tower]] on Bespin's Cloud City,<ref name="BWGITDB" /> the 3rd Wing Guard's [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]] were painted [[Color/Legends|orange]] and offered minimal protection to the pilots who flew them.<ref name="SWPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 3rd Wing Guard was represented by a miniature in the ''[[Scum & Villainy]]'' expansion of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''.<ref name="SWPM" />
